newsitem.title: USA: Melamine sells technology to DSM NV unit.
newsitem.headline: Melamine sells technology to DSM NV unit.

text.p: Melamine Chemicals Inc Wednesday said it will sell its patented high-pressure production technologies to DSM Melamine BV, a unit of DSM NV, for $25 million.

The Netherlands-based DSM will acquire the global rights to MCI's M-II and M-IV patents and related expertise. Melamine will retain the right to use this technology to build two additional plants in the Americas, Melamine said.
In exchange, MCI will receive $25 million of which $15 million is payable immediately and $10 million is payable in two equal installments in 2000 and 2005.

If this transaction is consummated, MCI will realize a $10.7 million gain net of $7.0 million in estimated costs associated with future developmental work, $600,000 in transaction costs and $6.7 million of income taxes.
Melamine anticipates this transaction will be consummated within the next three months.
DSM is required to assist MCI in modifying its low-pressure melamine plant to implement certain improvements developed by DSM Melamine.
Melamine is a chemical raw material with industrial and commercial applications and is used in many things including thermosetting plastics, adhesives and flame retardants.
